title: Review hibeam_g4 source geometry, scattering source, physics list, tables, and reproducibility
physics_validity_judgement: usable for first-order weighted truth studies, not yet production-grade or fully faithful for quantitative CCB detector-response claims

geometry_fidelity_assessment.judgement: compact CCB/Krakow model with CD2 target, two scintillator stack envelopes, bars, trigger bar, and ProtoTPC; not enough detail to prove full mechanical/material fidelity

correctness_issues.issue: Cross-section table is applied as PrimaryWeight after uniform angular sampling rather than as the event sampling distribution.
Possible centre-of-mass versus lab angle mismatch: sigma_pd_cm_190.txt appears CM-named but EvalWeight is called with lab theta3.
correctness_issues.consequence: Differential cross-section weights may be assigned in the wrong frame.

correctness_issues.issue: PAI model is constructed but SetExtraEmModel calls are commented out.
correctness_issues.consequence: The intended PAI gas ionization model is not active.

correctness_issues.issue: Run scripts do not pin seed or record source/input provenance in output.
correctness_issues.consequence: Existing output ROOT files are not independently reproducible.

next_tickets: S21b: Weighted scattering-source closure and geometry overlap audit
